name: Cork Seal
body:
School conjuration; Level adept 0, bard 0, sorcerer/wizard 0, summoner 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 minute
Components V, S, M (a cork or stopper)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target 1 bottle or vial
Duration permanent
Saving Throw Fort negates (object); Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You conjure a rubbery magical cork or other seal to stopper a bottle or vial of liquid. As you cast the spell, you declare a range of appropriate temperatures. If the bottle exceeds or goes below the temperature range, the cork turns red. If someone breaches the vessel, or if the vessel cracks, you receive an immediate mental alert.
